title: Pitch - Harbor Cold Brew launch
request:
Logline: a new oat milk cold brew in a can, for people who start work at 7. Twenty seconds from the Monday slump to the first sip.
Audience: office workers and students who grab a coffee on the way in.
Length and format: 20 s, 16:9, 4 shots.
Tone: warm, dry and quick. A small smile, not a hype reel.
Music: a soft beat that picks up when the can lands, and one bright chime on the end card.

briefBullets.label: Goal
briefBullets.text: Make people want to try the can next Monday morning.

briefBullets.label: Audience
briefBullets.text: People who start work early and buy coffee on the way in.

briefBullets.label: Feel
briefBullets.text: Warm and a little funny at the start, then bright and easy.

briefBullets.label: Shape
briefBullets.text: The slump, the can, three reasons, the offer.

briefBullets.label: Music
briefBullets.text: A soft beat that picks up when the can lands, then one chime at the end.

briefBullets.label: Not this
briefBullets.text: No hype, no stock-footage baristas, no slow-motion pours.

shots.title: Monday, 7:00
shots.caption: A dark desk at dawn. A big clock reads 7:00, an empty mug sits beside a long to-do list. The line: Monday. Again.
shots.animate: The clock flips from 6:59 to 7:00 at 0.8 s. The to-do list creeps up the right side. At 2 s the words rise one at a time and Again lands last, in orange.

bullets.label: See
bullets.text: A dark desk at dawn, a big clock at 7:00 and an empty mug.

bullets.label: Moves
bullets.text: The clock flips to 7:00, then the words rise one at a time.

bullets.label: Timing
bullets.text: The words are in by 3 seconds, so the joke has a beat to land.

bullets.label: Sound
bullets.text: One tired drum hit, then a clock tick.

shots.title: Meet Harbor
shots.caption: Hard cut to orange. The Harbor can drops into frame and bounces once, and cold drops bead on the metal. The line: Meet Harbor.
shots.animate: The can falls from above and lands on the first big beat, 0.5 s in, with one small bounce. Drops fade in across 1 s. The line slides up from the bottom at 2 s.

bullets.label: See
bullets.text: The Harbor can in the middle of a bright orange frame.

bullets.label: Moves
bullets.text: The can drops in and bounces once, then cold drops bead on it.

bullets.label: Timing
bullets.text: It lands on the first big beat, about half a second in.

bullets.label: Sound
bullets.text: A can opening on the landing, and the beat picks up.

bullets.label: Try first
bullets.text: Check the name on the can still reads on a phone.

shots.title: Three reasons
shots.caption: Three cards side by side: Oat milk, No added sugar, Twice the kick. The last one gets the orange shadow.
shots.animate: The cards flip in left to right, 0.5 s apart. The icons draw on as each card lands. Twice the kick gets a small shake when it arrives.

bullets.label: See
bullets.text: Three cards: Oat milk, No added sugar, Twice the kick.

bullets.label: Moves
bullets.text: The cards flip in one after another, left to right.

bullets.label: Timing
bullets.text: One card every half second, all three in by 1.5 seconds.

bullets.label: Sound
bullets.text: A light tap for each card.

shots.title: Your first can
shots.caption: The end card: the Harbor Cold Brew name, the offer Your first can is on us, and an Order now button.
shots.animate: The name fades up, the offer types on, and the button pulses twice, then everything holds still to the end.

bullets.label: See
bullets.text: The Harbor name, the offer and an Order now button.

bullets.label: Moves
bullets.text: The button gently pulses twice, then everything holds still.

bullets.label: Timing
bullets.text: Hold the end card for at least 3 seconds so people can read it.
